confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and cafe anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies widely by suburb and booking timing. July is Sydney winter, so accommodation assumes non-peak demand. FX: the 0.6955 observation (15 Oct 2026, 4pm) came from a search-result summary of the RBA exchange rates page. The F11 table itself was not opened, and a conflicting third-party figure was seen, so verify against the RBA table before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against other large Australian capitals with strong tourist demand, adjusted upward for Sydney's higher restaurant and accommodation costs. Cocktail and wine anchors are derived from the local price relationship to beer because direct knowledge of those prices is weaker.
